Compose_Support_Link.inputs:
@concat(
  'https://taskack.page.gd/support.html',
  '?ref=',
  uriComponent(
    outputs('Compose_Task_Ref')
  ),
  '&item=',
  string(coalesce(outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/ID'], 0)),
  '&email=',
  uriComponent(
    trim(
      replace(
        replace(
          string(coalesce(outputs('Get_item_Task_Email')?['body/AssignedTo'], '')),
          decodeUriComponent('%0D'),
          ''
        ),
        decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
        ''
      )
    )
  ),
  '&title=',
  uriComponent(
    trim(
      replace(
        replace(
          string(coalesce(outputs('Compose_TaskTitle'), '')),
          decodeUriComponent('%0D'),
          ''
        ),
        decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
        ' '
      )
    )
  ),
  '&src=email'
)
